First, we calculate $P(A\cup B)$ using the addition law:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(A\cup B) & =P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B) \\  & =\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{6}-\frac{1}{12} \\  & =\frac{3}{12}+\frac{2}{12}-\frac{1}{12} \\  & =\frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we construct the corresponding Venn diagram and shade the region ${A}^{′}\cup B.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14041480/assets/0c8d9572472da406cf84f5657d0ea47d0d1ba76592c98d4e6f442ecb9ef03dec.png)

Finally, we have

$$
P({A}^{′}\cup B)=\frac{1}{12}+\frac{1}{12}+\frac{2}{3}=\frac{5}{6}.
$$
